title: pilea angulata
intro: Pilea angulata, commonly known as Aluminum Plant or Watermelon Pilea, is a type of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant is known for its unique, watermelon-shaped leaves and is often used as a decorative element in indoor spaces. The health benefits of Pilea angulata include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Pilea angulata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-anxiety, anti-depressant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
